verdict.rationale: Logseq's documented interface is built around slash-commands, bracket syntax ([[ ]], (( )), {{query}}) rather than natural-language commands, and no first-party docs describe an NL command interface. The only related evidence is a community comment lamenting that using Claude/codex to write/update pages was possible via third-party plugin workflows but broke in the new DB version, which is not a documented first-party natural-language command capability.
